heading: Accuracy of information
body: Wasteful relies on schedules you enter yourself. We are not responsible for missed collections due to incorrect or outdated schedule information, or changes made by your local council.

heading: Third-party links

heading: No warranty
body: This app is provided as-is, without warranty of any kind, including reliability of reminders or notification delivery.
